therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PET imaging of urokinase plasminogen activator receptor
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: monitoring treatment response and predicting outcomes in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with bone metastases receiving Radium-223-dichloride treatment
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: uPAR PET/CT imaging and change in uPAR PET/CT after two cycles of Radium-223
